scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 11 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: This Matter Is Vital to Us
scenes.summary: Riding home as tabloids claim Xin Huimei has a secret child, Bu Xiaogu presses her well-connected admirer for the truth because the Golden Class lineup was just announced—trading a morning ride for confirmation that the rumor is false.

scenes.title: She Signed With Us and It Is My Duty
scenes.summary: Visiting Chun Yuqiao early in the morning, Wen Simo warns that an international brand is dropping Xin Huimei over the unrefuted child photos and urges Yuqiao to step in personally because Xingtian's talent unit is too weak.

scenes.title: I Had Too Much Work Last Night
scenes.summary: Dropped off at work in yesterday's outfit after staying up on files, Bu Xiaogu is teased mercilessly by Xiaoye about becoming her rich admirer's official girlfriend before greeting Kaiwen in the corridor.

scenes.title: Promoted to Full Planner
scenes.summary: Delivering completed files to Chun Yuqiao, Bu Xiaogu hears him credit her admirer for the Golden Class coup before he phones HR to make her a full planner immediately and orders her to return his spare laptop.

scenes.title: Promoted Ahead of Schedule
scenes.summary: Worried she did something wrong to make Chun Yuqiao angry, Bu Xiaogu asks Xingzi for advice, and Xingzi laughs that Manta Ray promoted her ahead of everyone because he favors her.

scenes.title: Check Where She Was Photographed
scenes.summary: Kaiwen barges in scolding Chun Yuqiao for losing his cool and frightening Bu Xiaogu, until Yuqiao tells him to shut up and orders him to find out where Xin Huimei was photographed and get her schedule.

scenes.title: Make No Inappropriate Moves
scenes.summary: While completing her promotion paperwork, Bu Xiaogu is warned by HR not to make any inappropriate moves that could hurt Chun Yuqiao; meanwhile Kaiwen decoys paparazzi away in Xin Huimei's car.

scenes.title: I Will Only Be With Someone I Truly Love
scenes.summary: Safe at a hotel, Xin Huimei confides to Chun Yuqiao that the boy is her father's child from an affair whom she took in to protect her parents' marriage—and refuses to fake a romance with anyone she does not truly love.

scenes.title: Let's Work Well Together From Now On
scenes.summary: After Xin Huimei's manager reports she wants to withdraw from Twelve Singers, Bu Xiaogu brings Chun Yuqiao his medicine; mindful of HR's warning, she calls him a distant idol, provoking him to end their unspoken pact.

scenes.title: Why Weigh Office Politics Against Happiness?
scenes.summary: Finding Bu Xiaogu drinking alone, Xingzi draws out her confession that every day at Xingtian has revolved around Chun Yuqiao and urges her to confess openly—only for Xin Huimei to answer Yuqiao's door.
scenes.location: evening bar and Chun Yuqiao's apartment doorway

scenes.title: Allow Me to Introduce My Boyfriend
scenes.summary: At the live press conference launching Twelve Singers Season Three hosted by Wen Simo, Xin Huimei addresses the secret-marriage rumors head-on and stuns reporters by introducing Chun Yuqiao as her boyfriend.

scenes.title: Luo Lin Offers to Coach Bai Yang
scenes.summary: Veteran diva Luo Lin invites young bar singer Bai Yang for a private meeting, reveals her past rift with Chun Yuqiao, and offers to coach Bai Yang personally on a demanding song.

scenes.title: Coordinating Both of Your Schedules
scenes.summary: Xin Huimei's manager asks Chun Yuqiao for his work calendar because Huimei cleared half her week hoping to spend time with him; hiding her heartache, Bu Xiaogu copies out Yuqiao's packed schedule.
scenes.location: Chun Yuqiao's office and Bu Xiaogu's desk

scenes.title: Leave My Schedule Alone From Now On
scenes.summary: Before flying overseas on business, Chun Yuqiao gets a playful office visit from Xin Huimei—who tells him romance is not an obligation—and then tells Bu Xiaogu in the airport car to stop managing his personal schedule.
